title: Merchant BNPL Integration Compliance Mapper
description: Map compliance obligations for merchants integrating BNPL at checkout. Covers PCI DSS scope determination by integration method, FCA Financial Promotions, EU CCD2 checkout disclosure standards, CFPB Reg Z advertising rules, and checkout UX standards. Outputs a prioritised compliance checklist and downloadable Markdown integration guide.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions of operation. At least one required.

integration_method.description: How BNPL is integrated into the merchant checkout flow.

promotes_bnpl.description: Whether the merchant actively promotes or advertises BNPL in marketing materials (emails, ads, banners, social). Triggers financial promotion and Reg Z advertising rules.

merchant_type.description: Whether the merchant operates online, in physical retail, or both.

pci_saq_type.description: Applicable PCI DSS SAQ type based on integration method.

total_items.description: Total number of compliance checklist items generated.

high_priority_count.description: Number of high-priority compliance items (regulatory breach risk).

mcp_tool_definition.name: map_merchant_bnpl_compliance_obligations
mcp_tool_definition.description: Generate a tailored BNPL integration compliance map for a merchant. Returns PCI DSS scope determination (SAQ type), per-jurisdiction regulatory disclosure requirements (FCA, EU CCD2, CFPB Reg Z), checkout UX standards, and a Markdown integration guide. Use when a merchant or platform team needs to identify compliance obligations before integrating a BNPL payment option at checkout.

integration_method_pci_scope.redirect: SAQ A — lowest scope; all payment functions outsourced to BNPL provider
integration_method_pci_scope.iframe: SAQ A-EP — moderate scope; Req. 6.4.3 script management mandatory
integration_method_pci_scope.whitelabel: SAQ D or QSA assessment — payment data flows through merchant systems
integration_method_pci_scope.inhouse: SAQ D or QSA assessment — full PCI DSS v4.0 scope; Req. 6.4.3 mandatory

notes: Client-side. Zero PII. All compliance item data is embedded in the HTML file. No external API calls. Output includes a downloadable Markdown integration guide.
